assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a history of cardiac arrhythmia (unspecified).
The patient reports persistent episodes of palpitations.
The palpitations interfere with the patient's daily activities.
The purpose of the ordered study is to further characterize the arrhythmia burden.
The purpose of the ordered study is to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances.
A 48-hour Holter monitor has been ordered.
The Holter monitor provides continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic recording.
The clinical indication of correlating symptoms with rhythm disturbances is documented in the case facts.
